lines.t: Yeah…

Still I rise, say “nevertheless”
Cravin’ that sin but I kill that noise
Face to the floor, I reject that choice
Not my will, I’ma ride with His
Die to the flesh, come alive in His
Eyes on the King, not the lust, no cap
Thug in the spirit, this that blood‑bought trap
